indication_area: Infectious disease (community-acquired bacterial pneumonia, acute bacterial skin and skin structure infections)
geography: U.S. (Forest held the U.S. rights; Forest's net sales by product)

approval_evidence.quote: 10/29/2010 ORIG-1 Approval Type 1 - New Molecular Entity STANDARD (NDA 200327, TEFLARO CEFTAROLINE FOSAMIL)

launch_evidence.quote: Sales of Teflaro, our newest marketed product, launched in March 2011, achieved sales of $2,716 in fiscal 2011.

series_start_reason: Teflaro was launched in March 2011 (2011Q1). Forest's filings print no Teflaro figure for April 2011-March 2012 quarters except two prior-year sentences in later releases ('$5.3 million in last year's second quarter', '$6.5 million in last year's third fiscal quarter') and the fiscal-2012 total ($22.4 million / 22,449 thousand), which leave April-June 2011 and January-March 2012 undetermined. The first quarter from which the series is contiguous is 2012Q2 (prior-year column of the fiscal-2014 June 10-Q), five quarters after launch.
series_end_reason: Forest's last report is the fiscal-2014 Form 10-K (quarter ended March 31, 2014); it filed no report for April-June 2014 and Form 15-12B on 2014-07-15, and Actavis plc closed the acquisition on July 1, 2014. Actavis/Allergan plc's own releases print no Teflaro row for 2014Q2-2015Q4 (rows first appear in the Q2 2016 release, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1578845/000114420416117011/v446159_ex99-1.htm, and a recast 8-K of 2016-10-06 gives 2015Q1 onward); 2014Q2-2014Q4 are printed by no issuer, a gap of three quarters, so the Forest series cannot be joined to Allergan's line and ends at 2014Q1.
search_log: Listed every filing (all forms) for CIK 38074 (Forest) and CIK 1578845 (Actavis/Allergan plc) via data.sec.gov/submissions incl. older pages; fetched every earnings 8-K exhibit and every 10-Q/10-K primary document (Forest 2002-07 to 2014-07, Allergan plc 2014-07 to 2020-06).

Searched every Forest document for Teflaro sentences with a dollar figure (prose.py) and table rows (rows.py): quarterly Teflaro figures exist only in the fiscal-2014 10-Q tables (current and prior-year three-month columns) and the fiscal-2013/2014 10-K tables (fiscal years).
